text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's Rice Shower! Rice Shower did not back
down! An excellent finish
in first!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Tenno Sho right around the
corner, Rice runs like her old
self again at
the Nikkei Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And as if galvanized by that performance,
McQueen takes the Osaka
Hai in
course-record time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They've both been training harder than
ever, pushing each other to
greater
heights.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And before long, the day of the Tenno
Sho arrives.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
In bracket two, post three, it's the sable
stayer who denied Mihono
Bourbon her
Triple Crown—Rice Shower!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Just follow McQueen... Just keep
following...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unfazed by the huge crowd before her,
Rice fixes her gaze on
McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wants to win against her rival more
than anything else. Her eyes
are telling me
so.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, the crowd favorite is, of
course...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
In bracket eight, post fourteen, today's
favorite with a third straight
spring Tenno
Sho on the line, it's the queen
herself—Mejiro
McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Wooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The loudest fanfare of the day resounds
for her, but McQueen
doesn't seem to
hear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Like her rival, she's focused on one thing,
and one thing
only—victory.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: The crowd's excited to see you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. Shouldn't you be going to
check up on Rice?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: I'm your trainer too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Heh. And I'm lucky to have such an
exemplary one. But please, go see
how
she's doing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
After all that training, I'm sure she's built
up enough confidence, but
she must still
be feeling anxious.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: I'm lucky to have such an exemplary ace on my team. Always looking out for others, even a rival.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: I'm lucky to have such an exemplary ace on my team. Always looking out for others, even a rival.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
For now, yes. Out on the turf, I can't make
any guarantees.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I will put everything I have into this race.
No holding back.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The crowd are hoping to witness the birth
of a three-time Tenno Sho
champion. And
their hopes give me strength.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I will be the first to cross that finish line.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't detect a single trace of hesitation in
her eyes. She means every
word.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Of course. I won't disappoint.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After speaking with McQueen, I jog ahead
to Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Nervous? The trick is to write
"Umamusume" on your palm and swallow

the word three times.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Nervous? The trick is to write
"Umamusume" on your palm and swallow

the word three times.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Heheheh. I've never heard that before.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm not that nervous, actually. It's just... I'm
a bit scared.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So many people are rooting for McQueen.
I know how much they
want to see her
third Tenno Sho win.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If I win, they'll all be disappointed. They'll
be angry with me for
getting in the way.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
The fact you're worried about that tells me
you're here to win.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. I still want to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her expression reminds me of McQueen
just now. Pure determination.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You know, it was McQueen who suggested
I have you race in the
Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You know, it was McQueen who suggested
I have you race in the
Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: McQueen?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, she wants to show you
something—a sight only a fellow
runner
can see.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, she wants to show you
something—a sight only a fellow
runner
can see.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: There's a... "sight" she wants me to see?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Okay. I'll see it for myself.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Mm. I will, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
They're lining up in the gate. The spring
Tenno Sho—who will the
glory go to?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Just follow McQueen... Keep following...
Just follow McQueen... Keep
following...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(Well I'll be... Wasn't expecting to feel so
much pressure from Rice.)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and here's the favorite, three-time
hopeful Mejiro McQueen
showing
hesitation before the gate.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(Still, I am a Mejiro, and our team's ace. I
must run with everything I
have.)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
There we go, Mejiro McQueen is in the
gate.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The spring Tenno Sho. Glory is 3,200
meters away. And... they're off!
